paragraphs: Rav Yehudah bar Shimon. Chullin 48a: when lung lesions came before R. Yochanan, he referred the cases to Rav Yehudah bar Shimon; see Rav Yitzchak bar Yosef. Bava Batra 114b: R. Yochanan said in Rav Yehudah bar Shimon's name. [The checked Bavli here calls him R. Yehudah son of R. Shimon.] Rashbam explains that because he was not his principal teacher, it says “in the name of,” since R. Yochanan did not regularly report his words. There, 115a, beginning: R. Yochanan objected to Rav Yehudah bar Shimon.
